_readme: Armory Table catalog. Every entry: category (weapons, armor, horse, shields, ranged, siege, decorations),
era (bronze, iron, steel, gunpowder), tech (technology the city needs), result (item stack) and cost
({"tag": ...} or {"item": ...} with a count). "kingOnly": true = only a king can make it.
removeRecipesFrom: every recipe whose result belongs to these mods is deleted (any recipe type),
except results whose id contains one of keepRecipes.
armorBalance: armor points per slot, toughness and knockback resistance (0-1) of every armor piece per era.
version: when the built-in file has a higher version, this file is replaced (old copy kept as .bak).
Costs grow with the era (metal x1 bronze, x1.5 iron, x2 steel, x2.5 gunpowder); every piece of
armor also needs wolf fur (valoris2:fur): 1 bronze, 2 iron, 3 steel. Steel armor also needs 1 bear fur (valoris2:bear_fur).
removeAllRecipesFrom: like removeRecipesFrom, but keepRecipes does not apply (ingots go too);
keepRecipeIds: recipes whose id starts with one of these are always kept.

armorBalance._comment: Every armor piece of an era gets these values, whatever mod it comes from.
armorBalance._horse: horse: armor points of horse armor (Armory Table "horse" tab) in that era.
